details.description: Eleven Flash v2.5 is ElevenLabs' fastest text-to-speech model, designed for real-time applications and its Agents Platform, with latency of about 75ms excluding application and network latency. It supports 32 languages: every language covered by Eleven Multilingual v2 plus Hungarian, Norwegian, and Vietnamese. It generates up to 40,000 characters (about 40 minutes of audio) per request, the highest limit among ElevenLabs' current flagship speech synthesis models, and balances speed with quality for interactive use.
advantages: Ultra-low latency of about 75ms, excluding application and network latency, per ElevenLabs' model documentation.
Supports 32 languages: every language covered by Eleven Multilingual v2, plus Hungarian, Norwegian, and Vietnamese.
Supports up to 40,000 characters (about 40 minutes of audio) per request, the highest limit among ElevenLabs' current flagship speech synthesis models.
ElevenLabs recommends it for real-time voice agents, interactive applications and games, and large-scale bulk text-to-speech conversion.
disadvantages: Numbers, dates, and currencies are not normalized by default (to keep latency low); ElevenLabs recommends Eleven Multilingual v2 instead when accurate number normalization matters, or enabling text normalization, which is available only on Enterprise plans for this model.
use_cases: Real-time voice agents and chatbots on ElevenLabs' Agents Platform
Interactive applications and games requiring immediate response

notes: The maker's page also states Flash v2.5 has a 50% lower price per character than previous models; that price comparison is left out per the no-price-claims style rule.
